content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Adult postsecondary degree provider serving military and working learners, not K-12 public school programs or curriculum."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Payroll, HR and tax outsourcing for employers; no education delivery or curriculum overlap."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Nonprofit fundraising and school administration software; does not deliver curriculum or run virtual schools."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Corporate leadership training, consulting and planners; different customers and content from K-12 education."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced marketing and enrollment services paid by one university; does not sell instruction or curriculum."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Healthcare workforce software and patient surveys sold to hospitals; unrelated to K-12 education."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Sells digital K-12 curriculum, learning platforms and assessments to school districts, closely matching Stride's core offering."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Cloud payroll and HCM software for employers; no education or learning delivery overlap."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Tuition-funded degree programs for adult students; no K-12 public school contracts or curriculum sales."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Working-adult degree and certificate programs paid by students or employers; different customers from K-12 public schools."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone, video and contact center software for businesses; no education content or school customers."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Hands-on technical training campuses paid by students; different model from virtual K-12 schooling and curriculum."}]}
